content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I was programming using [product_name] demo version because we plan to install [product_name] at my house. Everything worked well and I saved the project on my laptop. However, after a few days, when I tried to make changes, I received the error: "invalid type code: 9A". Can anyone clarify what this error means? Thanks in advance.

I attempted to open your project using [product_name] V7.0.30, but it failed with the error: "Error opening file: [path- and filename]". It appears there may have been an issue when saving your project.

analysis.insight_summary: The main usability issue observed is a file corruption or compatibility error when working with [product_name] V7 demo mode. Users encountered obstacles accessing previously saved project files, indicating instability or insufficient mechanisms for error handling and data recovery in the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to open, edit, and continue working on previously saved projects in [product_name] V7 demo without encountering data loss or errors.
